narrative.northStar: The Drawing Sheet Under the Film Still
narrative.overview: Every page has two materials and a hard cut between them: a grainy film still of real hardware above, an engineering drawing sheet below, framed, zone-ruled and closed by a title block. Light is a drawing print, dark is CAD model space; the only colour is redline red on data.
keyCharacteristics: A full-bleed film still above, a framed sheet below, a zone ruler as the seam.
Two line weights: 1px for rules and hairlines, 2px for the frame, view-title underlines and step heads.
Every number sits in a table, a spec list, a dimension or a figure cell, set in Overpass Mono with tabular figures.
Square corners everywhere except the item balloons.
One authored motion: the servo trace redraws and the lag re-dimensions when the move time changes.

rules.name: The Redline Rule
rules.body: Red marks data, never chrome. If it is not a trace, a lag or a dimension, it is linework.

rules.name: The Two Blacks Rule
rules.body: The film black and the sheet ground are never the same value; in dark mode a 2px pale ruler line marks where film ends.

rules.name: The Measured Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono only for things that were measured, counted or dated. Prose and headings never go mono.

dos: Do put every new number in a table row, a spec list or a dimension, with its source or status beside it.
Do underline every view title at 2px.
Do number figures ("Fig. n") with a CSS counter in mono.
Do keep the film still a real photograph of real hardware, graded low-key black and white, with text only in its empty space.
donts: Don't use red outside data (The Redline Rule).
Don't add rounded cards, shadows or gradients to the sheet.
Don't put a label above a heading.
Don't set any text in the Styro logo face.
Don't let the sheet ground match the film black in dark mode.
